description: This PHP file defines the ErrorPage class, which extends SimplePage. It is used to generate error pages with specific types such as normal, missing page, or fatal errors, and renders HTML using a template system.

classes.name: ErrorPage
classes.description: A class representing an error page, capable of rendering different types of error messages.
